name: X1
summary:
X1 is AgiBot's open humanoid development platform for research, education and experimentation with embodied intelligence. The robot uses a modular design intended to make hardware and software development more accessible. AgiBot lists a height of 130 cm, a mass of 33 kg and 31 degrees of freedom.

Its published walking and arm-load figures describe a lightweight experimental platform rather than a heavy-duty industrial handler. The open development approach supports work on robot motion, perception and control, with researchers able to build and evaluate their own applications. Demonstrations

description.en:
X1 is AgiBot's open humanoid development platform for research, education and experimentation with embodied intelligence. The robot uses a modular design intended to make hardware and software development more accessible. AgiBot lists a height of 130 cm, a mass of 33 kg and 31 degrees of freedom.

Its published walking and arm-load figures describe a lightweight experimental platform rather than a heavy-duty industrial handler. The open development approach supports work on robot motion, perception and control, with researchers able to build and evaluate their own applications. Demonstrations and published hardware limits should be assessed separately from the behavior achieved by a particular software configuration.
